MEMORANDUM
To: Mayor Patrick Collins, and City Council
Date:1/18/2022
From: John Kopper
Fire Chief
Reference: Staffing for Adequate Fire and Emergency Response (SAFER) Grant
1. Cheyenne Fire Rescue is requesting approval to submit an application for the FY21
Staffing for Adequate Fire and Emergency Response(SAFER) Grant Program.The
SAFERgrant was created to provide funding directly tofire departments and volunteer
firefighter interest organizations tohelp them increase or maintain thenumber of trained,
"front line”firefighters available in their communities.
2.The goal of SAFER is to enhance the local fire departments' abilities to comply with
staffing, response and operational standards established by theNFPA(NFPA 1710 and/or
NFPA 1720).
3.Theproposed grant will provide for the addition of 9firefighters at Cheyenne Fire Rescue,
capabilities throughout our entire community with the addition of the firefighters.It will
alsoimprove overtime costs associated with reduced staffing levels due to illness, injuries,
and administrative absences.
4.It is essential to our community and to the safety of our members that we seek alternatives
to thefunding of additional personnel to meet national consensus standards and increasing
growth. Your support is greatly appreciated. If you have any questions, please feel free to
reach out to me.
Funding: Grant, No match,$ 2,970,790.00
Respectfully,
John Kopper
Fire Chief

WHEREAS, The goal of SAFER is to enhance the local fire departments'abilities tocomply

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
